name: atlas-db-docs
description: Read-only Oracle and SQL Server schema metadata tools for allowlisted schemas.

profiles_file.title: Profiles file (profiles.toml)
profiles_file.description: Choose config\profiles.toml of your Atlas folder to reach your databases. If left empty, only the packaged sample profile (db.example.com) is available.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables in an allowlisted schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Column names, types, sizes and nullability.

tools.name: list_constraints
tools.description: Primary, foreign, unique and check constraints.

tools.name: get_column_defaults
tools.description: Column default expressions and virtual/hidden/identity flags.
